notes:
Assets: Getting the elements that will be edited and used in the creation of the mod: - Characters, text, animation, 3d models, fonts, audio, etc. Obtaining everything that will be used in order to achieve the results, aka also the things the audience will view.

Build/configure: Put the blocky world together, add an Ash-Steve character so he can walk around, and set up the basic controls for throwing Pokéballs and catching Pokémon as well of building like in a Minecraft world.

The output: is for are mod to allow the player/consumer to be able to throw a poke ball to a Minecraft mob it will also make a custom world when loaded for the player with bits of Pokémon while still looking like Minecraft.

Results: We have achieved the results we wanted. We wanted to make a mod pack for the video game Minecraft where we added a poke-ball from Pokemon.
